description: Check whether an IP sits inside a netblock on a curated keyless reputation list — Spamhaus DROP/EDROP (networks judged hijacked or bad-actor-controlled) and FireHOL level1 (a conservative aggregate of established abuse lists). Returns each list that matched with the matching CIDR and a reference, and which lists were reachable. Different from ip_reputation (GreyNoise scanner telemetry) and blacklist_check (mail DNSBLs): this is 'sits in a known-bad network' reputation. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Read-only, never contacts the target.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 185.220.101.1 or example.com

name: ip_blocklist_check
